title: Ugly stick
summary: The ugly stick is a homemade instrument: a long pole hung with bells, flattened bottle caps and tin cans, with a rubber boot on its foot. Stamped on a board and shaken, it rattles, jingles and thumps all at once, and keeps the beat for a kitchen party.
howToPlay: Four places are lit: Bells at the top, Caps on the slat, Tin on the pole, and the Stomp at the foot.
Strike the place a closing ring marks. The stick jumps and its pieces ring.
The stomp is the beat; the rest of the stick dresses it up.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: Because it is built from whatever the maker has, no two ugly sticks look alike. In Newfoundland it keeps the beat for kitchen-party music.
credits: Tradition: the ugly stick; patterns written for this game
